name: Report to Helgrum
summary: Neeka Bloodscar has written a fresh report for Helgrum the Swift in Stonard, and asks you to carry it there. This follows your visit to Neeka at Kargath.

sections.title: A Report for Stonard
sections.body: Neeka Bloodscar has written a new report for Helgrum in Stonard and hands it to you. Neeka adds that anyone who calls themselves an outrunner must not lose the way, or fall to an enemy.

sections.title: Helgrum Reads the Report
sections.body: Reading Neeka's report, Helgrum sees that the Alliance has troubles of its own. Helgrum also thinks the Horde and the Alliance may turn out to share some enemies.

faq.q: Who sends you with the report?
faq.answer: Neeka Bloodscar, who has written a fresh report for Helgrum.

faq.q: Where does the report need to be delivered?
aliases: where to turn in report to helgrum
faq.answer: To Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.
It follows the earlier step in which Helgrum sent you to speak with Neeka Bloodscar at Kargath.
